label: Reorg-safe indexer buffer
summary: A bounded defensive-copy canonical-chain buffer with normalized hashes, canonical duplicate identity, unfinalized rollback and one inspectable finalized anchor.
maturityMeaning: Deterministic reusable source is packaged and hash-bound; project integration, tests and review are still required.
requiredFacts: Bind deployment start blocks, confirmation depth and canonical block-hash source
Persist finalized checkpoints and derived rows in one atomic transaction, then prune only blocks below the retained finalized anchor
Deep-copy ingested records and emitted finalized snapshots so caller mutation cannot rewrite buffered canonical state
Normalize block hashes and require duplicate number-plus-hash snapshots to have the same canonical parent and record digest
Accept only bounded dense arrays with canonical index properties and acyclic plain data objects as records; reject accessors, exotic objects and oversized structures with controlled errors
Reconcile event-derived state against confirmed onchain reads
hardConflictPredicates: An orphaned log can remain in published state after its block leaves the canonical chain
A finalized checkpoint or retained anchor can be silently rewritten, lost or pruned without a hold or operator alert
Caller mutation of an input block or returned finalized record can mutate the internal canonical buffer
The same normalized block number and hash can be replayed with a different parent or record snapshot
Cyclic, exotic or unbounded record values can bypass deterministic snapshot identity or crash validation
Backfill can skip a failed range and still advance the published cursor
